canonical_data: a run directory holding the program archive, island populations, per-generation evaluation results, and configuration under the user's own filesystem or Slurm scratch
strengths: The correctness gate is real for a research lab's release: roughly seventy test files, a continuous-integration job that runs type checking and coverage-reported tests, and a weekly credential-backed job exercising six live providers
A headless mode makes the mutation operator a full coding agent the user already subscribes to, driving Codex or Claude Code under the evolutionary loop instead of a raw completion call
Evaluation dispatch spans the local host, containers, and Slurm, so the same run definition scales from a laptop to a cluster without changing the search configuration
weaknesses: The published package still declares alpha development status, which sits oddly beside three releases in three months and a coverage-gated pipeline
In the default path the model fills one slot — propose a mutation — inside a pipeline the caller configured, and only the headless mode puts a tool-using agent in that position
The loop is long-running and unattended by design, and the primary controls are configuration files set before the run rather than intervention during it
why_it_matters: The only one of its lab's published agentic systems that is engineered as software rather than as a paper artifact, and a working example of coding agents used as the variation operator inside an outer search loop.
